priceSnapshot.note: THE WALL BROKE. Spot 64,273.2 against morning's 63,613.2 - UP 660.0 points, +1.04%, in five and three quarter hours, and up 1.78% on the 24-hour. Morning nominated 63,798-64,025 as the wall and set the add gate at a settled 4H close above 63,970.0. The 12:00Z 4H bar settled at 64,203.6. The gate fired. Price is now above ALL FOUR 4H EMAs including the ema200 at 63,983.1, and above the daily ema20 at 63,911.4 for the first time in this sequence. The session since the morning snapshot ran 63,439.5 to 64,427.4 - a 987.9-point range, more than double the morning window - and the low never came within 151.7 points of morning's reduce line at 63,287.8.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below $63,979.7 - the low of the 17:00Z bar and 3.4 points under the 4H ema200 at 63,983.1. The line rises 691.9 points from morning's 63,287.8, and it rises because the structure being defended is a full timeframe higher again: morning defended a reclaim of the 1H ema200 and 4H ema50, this report defends a reclaim of the 4H ema200 AND the daily ema20 (63,911.4). A settled close under 63,979.7 loses both in one move and drops price back under the 4H ema100 at 63,817.7, which is the level that rejected the first test this morning.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 4H close above $64,427.4 - the session high, which also clears the daily ema50 at 64,359.9 by 67.5 points. That pair is the next wall and it is the last one before the daily structure genuinely turns. The confirmation beyond price is UNCHANGED and STILL UNMET: morning asked for a break that runs on RISING open interest as the first evidence a buyer rather than a coverer is doing the work. Open interest fell a further 0.55% while this break happened. Until a leg up prints with OI rising, every gate that fires should be sized as a covering rally, not a trend.

decisionBox.changed: ADD for a third consecutive session, and this one is the desk following its own plan rather than improvising. Morning bought 15 USDT at 63,613.2 and wrote in the ledger that the remaining 32 USDT of cash was being held 'for the wall break'. The wall broke on the 12:00Z 4H settle at 64,203.6, so the cash gets deployed - but at 14 USDT, not the full 32, because the one confirmation morning explicitly asked for did not arrive. Open interest is DOWN another $11,401,387 (0.55%) to $2,053,725,764 across the same span price rose 660 points, the long/short account ratio has fallen again to 1.70 from 1.92 at 12:00Z, and realized shorts liquidated $7,133,381 against $1,938,175 of longs - a 3.68-to-1 squeeze. That is a covering rally by every measure available, and covering rallies end when the covering does. The reduce line rises 691.9 points to 63,979.7 to sit under the newly reclaimed 4H ema200 and daily ema20. Invalidation rises 766.0 points from 62,521.8 to 63,287.8 - the 08:00Z 4H bar low and the base the whole day was built from; a return there erases the session and the thesis with it. stopOrder stays NOT recommended: no futures are open and the next report is roughly seven hours away in daylight, not an overnight gap.

liquidityMagnet.note: The feed passed the freshness guard for a second consecutive session - newest fill 17:36:08Z at 64,038.5, about eleven minutes old at read time - so no CoinGlass browser fallback was needed. This is REALIZED (burned) leverage, not resting orders, and the distinction matters more this run than last. Of $9,071,556 liquidated in the window, $7,133,381 was SHORTS against $1,938,175 longs: a 3.68-to-1 squeeze, up from 1.59-to-1 at the morning read. The flow points UP and the pull field says so. But the two heaviest bands above spot, 64,400 and 64,300, were both burned within the last two hours by the move that just happened. Spent fuel above and an empty map past 64,500 is a two-sided reading: it means little friction if the break extends, and it means the short-side fuel that has powered five sessions of covering is being used up. The honest caveat from the morning read still stands - a spent band and an unresolved resting magnet are indistinguishable on this feed.

liquidations.note: FOUR SESSIONS OF PRICE UP AND OPEN INTEREST DOWN. OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP open interest is $2,053,725,764 read live in-browser at 17:48:15Z against morning's $2,065,127,150 - DOWN $11,401,387 or 0.55% - and down 3.23% from endday's $2,122,316,880, while price rose 660.0 points across the same span and 1,551.9 points from the 16 August low. This is short covering, and it is now covering that has broken a wall the desk named in advance. Morning set rising OI as the confirmation that a real buyer had arrived; it did not arrive, and that is the single most important qualifier on this report. The OKX long/short account ratio is 1.70 on the 17:00Z print against 1.92 at 12:00Z and 2.24 at endday - retail long crowding has unwound 0.54 in eighteen hours. Funding has COLLAPSED to +0.00125% into the 00:00Z settlement from +0.00434% at the morning read, a 71% drop: perpetual longs are paying almost nothing to hold, which is the opposite of what a crowded, euphoric long book looks like. Total $9,071,556 liquidated, of which $7,133,381 was SHORTS against $1,938,175 longs - a 3.68-to-1 squeeze, more than double the 1.59-to-1 ratio six hours ago. calibration.note: The prior report is today's 2026-08-17-morning, published at 07:10:00-05:00 with spot at 63,613.2. Its reduce line at 63,287.8 did NOT fire and was never threatened - the session low of 63,439.5 stopped 151.7 points clear and no 1H bar came close to settling under it. Its add gate at 63,970.0 DID fire, on the 12:00Z 4H bar settling at 64,203.6. This is the first add gate to fire in the file, and it fired on the exact mechanism morning specified - a settled 4H close, not an intraday wick. actingHelped is TRUE. Morning bought 15 USDT of spot at 63,613.2, roughly 0.00023580 BTC, and spot marks 660.0 points higher at 64,273.2 - about +0.156 USDT. Small in absolute terms, but it is the largest single-session gain on any entry in the file and, more importantly, the reasoning survived contact. Morning made three specific calls and got all three right: it refused to lower the add gate after the failed test, arguing that moving it down would reward a failed test - and the gate then cleared on its own terms six hours later. It raised the reduce line 447.8 points to sit under the new structure rather than the old, and that line was never tested. It held size at 15 USDT while explicitly reserving 32 USDT for the wall break, and the wall broke. Two sessions in a row where restraint was rewarded is a genuine break from the 14-16 August pattern. THE HONEST QUALIFIER, and it is the reason this report sizes at 14 rather than 32: morning also named the confirmation it wanted alongside the price gate - rising open interest - and that did not arrive. OI fell another 0.55% through the break. The desk got the level right and did not get the participation it asked for, and it should not pretend the second thing does not matter because the first thing worked.
